summary: Sanara MedTech held a special meeting on September 30, 2026, where shareholders approved the July 29, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with MiMedx Group and its Mustang Merger Sub, with 6,372,989 votes for, 1,944 against, and 36,494 abstaining. Tendered shares represented 69.78% of the 9,188,035 shares outstanding as of the September 1 record date. The non-binding golden-parachute compensation proposal also passed, and the adjournment proposal was withdrawn as moot. The merger remains subject to customary closing conditions before Sanara becomes a wholly-owned MiMedx subsidiary; deal terms and premium were not restated in this 8-K.
